selector.rationale: Decisive findings of lumbar spinal tenderness, bilateral leg weakness, and MRI signal changes at L4-L5 best explained by Spondylodiscitis, with Enterobacter cloacae infection as a likely cause.

rejected.label: Osteomyelitis
rejected.why: Less specific evidence and lower score compared to Spondylodiscitis

rejected.label: Anastomotic fistula
rejected.why: Already treated and not directly related to current symptoms

rejected.label: Enterobacter cloacae infection
rejected.why: While present, it is not a diagnosis but rather a contributing factor to the champion diagnosis

rejected.label: Epidural abscess
rejected.why: Although a high score, the specific findings and MRI changes point more directly to Spondylodiscitis
